title: Minimal real SWAP management to real Ribasim aligned-boundary fixture

ribasim_pin.release_context: v2026.1.1 product-release authority already used by the frozen characterization

frozen_sequence: derive RM07 read-only receipt from accepted SWAP management checkpoint
convert receipt depth to Ribasim UserDemand using represented area
initialize an accepted real Ribasim origin without advancing it
run candidate A from the same serialized Ribasim origin and discard it
prove accepted Ribasim origin did not advance and accumulated no UserDemand inflow
run candidate B independently from the same serialized origin
require candidate A/B allocation, physical supplied volume and Basin endpoint replay
feed candidate-B allocated and physically supplied equivalent depths into RM06
reject first SWAP candidate, replay from same checkpoint, commit second candidate exactly once
hypotheses: Real Ribasim allocates the full 2 cm equivalent request because the frozen case has sufficient supply.
Real Ribasim physically supplies the full request over the accepted one-day window.
Discarding candidate A does not mutate the accepted Ribasim origin.
Candidate B reproduces candidate A within frozen replay tolerances.
Allocation and physical supply remain separately observed quantities even when numerically equal in this sufficient-supply case.
The real Ribasim quantities are accepted by the same RM06 SWAP transaction without changing the original RM07 request.
failure_rule: Scientific expectations and tolerances are frozen before execution. Only technical setup or compiler failures may be repaired automatically.
nonclaims: No full Richards hydrological application yet.
Discard/promote of separate Ribasim model instances is a qualification fixture transaction pattern, not a claimed production checkpoint API.
